gaps.sentence: The plane will drop ___ the parcels at the next farm.
gaps.explanation: drop off = deliver somebody/something; also become less (sales dropped off).

gaps.sentence: Please carry ___ with your work; don't mind me.
gaps.explanation: carry on = continue; carry out = perform (a task).

gaps.sentence: It took the committee weeks to wade ___ the paperwork.
gaps.hint: wade ___ = plod through a lot of
gaps.explanation: 'Wade through' = work slowly through a large amount of tedious material.

gaps.sentence: The old buses are being phased ___ next year.
gaps.explanation: phase out = stop using something gradually.

gaps.sentence: The plane takes ___ in ten minutes.
gaps.explanation: take off = leave the ground (plane); also remove clothes; become successful (career took off).

gaps.sentence: The film didn't live up ___ my expectations.
gaps.explanation: live up TO something = be as good as expected.

gaps.sentence: Prices levelled ___ after the crazy spring market.
gaps.explanation: level off = stop rising or falling and stay the same.

gaps.sentence: A new proposal was put ___ at the meeting.
gaps.explanation: put forward = propose, suggest (an idea, plan, name).
